profile.headline: Security Architect
profile.summary: I am a result driven lead security engineer with proven expertise in implementing company-wide governance controls. I create worldwide organizational processes that intersect the software product delivery lifecycle and provide regulatory guidance at an engineering level.

positions.title: Senior System Software Engineer
positions.description: I secure super computers sold to cloud service providers specialized in hosting large language models that perform inference at scale. Specifically I manage the secure development lifecycle for firmware on the data center product line.
positions.insights: Skills: Public Key Cryptography · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Secure SDLC · PKI · Product Life Cycle

positions.insights: Skills: Windows Azure · Data Privacy · Gap Analysis · General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) · Identity Governance · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · NIST 800-53 · Powershell

positions.title: Senior Security Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: I worked directly with engineering leaders to enable security strategy for DoorDash’s cloud infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Information Security · Okta · Security Architecture Design · Snowflake · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · GitHub

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer
positions.description: I created artificial intelligence software for use within the Amazon Fulfillment Centers by reliability maintenance engineers to fix robotics issues globally.

positions.title: Security Consultant
positions.description: I advised the United States Army on best practices for implementing secure well-architected applications, identity solutions, and landing zones that follow the Department of Defense Secure Cloud Computing requirements.

positions.insights: Skills: Windows Azure · Information Security · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · NIST 800-53 · Public Key Cryptography
